email.subject: AI for Marin/Goodman LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Richard,

Your concierge approach to serving businesses and high net worth individuals across New York and New Jersey demands precision your team can't sacrifice, even as you manage national risks across multiple jurisdictions. That's exactly what caught our attention.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms managing BigLaw-level demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by Harrison to show how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete without losing the hands-on counsel your clients expect.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
